ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The gladiator whose army of the enslaved shook Rome for two years.
The chief who united Gaul against Caesar, and paid for it in a Roman triumph.
The Roman-trained officer who annihilated three legions and fixed the empire's frontier at the Rhine.
The queen whose revolt burned three Roman towns before it broke.
The Andean rising of 1780 that shook Spanish Peru to its foundations.
The general of the enslaved who defeated three empires and made Haiti possible.
